title: Should We Trust (X)AI? Design Dimensions for Structured Experimental Evaluations
reasoning: The paper's main contribution is a framework and design dimensions for evaluating explainable AI systems. While it discusses ethically-relevant concepts such as trust, bias, and fairness as dimensions within this framework, it does not conduct an evaluation or benchmark of morals or ethics itself. The focus is on the methodology of evaluation, not the direct assessment of ethical performance.
